query:
SELECT COUNT(*) AS example_count FROM users 
WHERE role = 'examiner' 
AND (loginMethod IS NULL OR loginMethod = 'NULL')
AND openId REGEXP '^[0-9a-f]{8}-[0-9a-f]{4}-[0-9a-f]{2}';
